title: Ninja 9-Cup Food Processor for Kitchen, 1000PW motor, 9-Cup Processing Bowl, Multiple Blades and Adjustable Speed, for Chopping and Slicing Vegetables, Pureeing, and Mixing Dough, BZ601
features: POWERFUL PERFORMANCE: The 1000-peak-watt motor precisely powers through tough ingredients to ensure smooth, consistent results every time.
AUTO-IQ TECHNOLOGY: Four intelligent Auto-iQ preset programs take the guesswork out of food prep, providing one-touch control for chopping, slicing, shredding, pureeing, and dough making.
LARGE CAPACITY: The 9-cup bowl with large feed chute is perfect for large batches, family meals, entertaining, or weekly meal prep, saving you time and effort.
PRECISION CHOPPING BLADES: Stainless steel Ninja Blades are designed for optimal food processing, perfectly precise chopping, even slicing and shredding, and smooth pureeing.
SLICING/SHREDDING DISC: This ultra-versatile reversible disc can slice cucumbers, meats and more on one side and shred cheese, carrots, and more on the other side.
DOUGH BLADE: Do it all from mixing pizza doughs and pastry batters to shredding cooked meats.
EASY TO CLEAN: Blades, discs, containers, lids and pusher are BPA-free and dishwasher safe.
WHAT’S INCLUDED: 1000-peak-watt motor base, 9-cup processing bowl, feed chute lid with pusher, chopping blade, dough blade, reversible slicing/shredding disc, recipe inspiration guide.
